text.p: ADT Ltd said Wednesday that its preliminary opinion was that the proposed exchange offer by Western Resources Inc was "inadequate."

In a letter to shareholders, ADT said, "the preliminary view of its board of directors, based on the limited information presently available, is that Western Resources, Inc.'s proposed exchange offer is inadequate."

It said the reduction is due to a non-recurring charge from the integration of the security businesses acquired recently as part of Automated Security (Holdings) in addition to costs associated with planned technological infrastructure enhancements.
It said the integration of the businesses into ADT should bring about "significant future cost savings."
It said it expected that these two items together will result in a total non-recurring charge of about $110 million after taxes.
ADT said the board convened a special general meeting of shareholders for July 8, and that a notice of the special general meeting has been sent to the shareholders.
ADT said it expects net income in the 1996 fourth quarter to be reduced by about $60 million, after allowing for the gain on the sale of an asset.
